nights.title: JOHN SUMMIT - EUROPE CTRL ESCAPE TOUR
nights.name: John Summit
nights.extract: John Walter Schuster, better known by his stage name John Summit, is an American DJ and record producer, former accountant and current owner of the Experts Only label. His music includes original tracks and remixes, primarily focused in the genre of tech house.

en.who: John Summit is the stage name of John Walter Schuster. He is also a former accountant and the current owner of the Experts Only label. His music includes original tracks and remixes, primarily focused in the genre of tech house.

tr.who: John Summit, John Walter Schuster'ın sahne adıdır. Eski bir muhasebeci olan sanatçı, şu an Experts Only plak etiketinin sahibidir. Müziği orijinal parçaları ve remiksleri kapsar, ağırlıklı olarak tech house türünde üretir.
